messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries

messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries
messages.en: {the_monster_1} says, "No facts are to me sacred; none are profane; I simply experiment, an endless seeker, with no past at my back."
messages.zh: {the_monster_1}说：“对我来说没有神圣的事实，也没有亵渎的事实；我只是不断实验，一个无止境的求索者，身后不留过去。”

messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries
messages.en: {the_monster_1} says, "The present is the child, and the necessary child, of all the past, and the mother of all the future."
messages.zh: {the_monster_1}说：“现在是所有过去的孩子，也是必然的孩子，又是所有未来的母亲。”

messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries
messages.en: {the_monster_1} says, "Reason is nothing but a wonderful and unintelligible instinct in our souls."
messages.zh: {the_monster_1}说：“理性不过是我们灵魂中一种奇妙而不可解的直觉。”

messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries
messages.en: {the_monster_1} says, "It is extremely absurd to expect to be enlightened by reason, and yet to prescribe to it beforehand on which side it must incline."
messages.zh: {the_monster_1}说：“一方面期待被理性启蒙，一方面又预先规定理性必须倾向哪一边，这是极其荒谬的。”

messages.context: Selected raw monster speech grammar, before recursive children and semantic actor parameters; preserve source English only for reviewed proper names/onomatopoeia/protocol-only entries
messages.en: {the_monster_1} says, "The real reality is there, but everything you KNOW about 'it' is in your mind and yours to do with as you like."
messages.zh: {the_monster_1}说：“真实的现实就在那里，但你对‘它’所知道的一切都在你自己脑中，随你怎么处置。”

test_cases.zh: 兽人低声说：“这一切都是一场梦——一场荒诞而愚蠢的梦。”

test_cases.canonical: orc whispers, "Soon you will have time, lots of time..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人低声说：“很快你就会拥有时间，大把大把的时间……”

test_cases.canonical: orc voice, "You must not fail where I succeeded!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人 声音：“我成功了，你绝不能失败！”

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc yawns, and then pretends voice didn't.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人打了个哈欠，随后假装声音什么也没做。
兽人说：“困了吗？”
兽人说：“我刚才才没有睡着！”
TALK:兽人威胁地嘶嘶作声。

test_cases.canonical: orc screams voice, "I'll haunt your nightmares!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人尖叫 声音：“我要闯入你的噩梦！”
TALK:兽人鞠了一躬。

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "You dishonour your ancestors."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“你辱没了你的祖先。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I despise a dishonourable opponent."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我鄙视不名誉的对手。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "It is my duty to kill you, but also my pleasure."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“杀了你是我的职责，也是我的乐趣。”

test_cases.canonical: orc mutters, "I never trained for this."
test_cases.zh: 兽人咕哝道：“我从没受过这种训练。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "You will find the Path of Peace easy to follow, in death."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“死后，你会发现和平之路很好走。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "May you follow the Path of Peace in your next life."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“愿你来世走上和平之道。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Your soul will be trapped in ice for ten thousand years."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你的灵魂将在冰中被囚禁一万年。”
声音
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Follow my lead, little ones."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“跟着我走，小家伙们。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I resented this body once, but could any human make what I've made?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我曾憎恨这具躯体，但哪个人类能做出我这样的作品？”

test_cases.canonical: orc snarls, "I will not be driven out again."
test_cases.zh: 兽人咆哮道：“我不会再被赶走。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Come closer, little fly."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“再靠近些，小苍蝇。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I'm done suffering for art; you can suffer instead."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我已为艺术受够了苦；换成你来受苦吧。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "My silk is a match for both steel and spell."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我的蛛丝既敌得过钢铁，也敌得过法术。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I will spin a new home for us all."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我要为我们大家织一个新家。”
兽人疯狂地大笑。
兽人愤怒地嚎叫。

test_cases.canonical: orc screams voice, "Burn! Burn! All of it must BURN!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人尖叫 声音：“烧！烧！一切都必须烧掉！”
TALK:兽人吐出一个个烟圈。
TALK:兽人双眼仿佛燃起火焰。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc is momentarily hidden by a cloud of flames.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人一时被一团火焰遮住了身影。

test_cases.canonical: orc grumbles, "Damn that jealous turtle monk."
test_cases.zh: 兽人嘟囔道：“那只爱嫉妒的龟和尚，真该死。”

test_cases.canonical: orc pines for voice lost husband.
test_cases.zh: 兽人为声音亡夫/亡妻而黯然神伤。

test_cases.canonical: orc roars, "Even the heavens can't separate us forever!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人吼道：“就算是老天也不能永远把我们分开！”

test_cases.canonical: orc inspects voice gathered herbal reagents.
test_cases.zh: 兽人检查着声音采集来的草药材料。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc twists and twirls voice body through the storm.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人在风暴中扭动、旋转着声音身躯。

TALK:兽人安详地咧嘴一笑。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc is briefly surrounded by a halo of voice light.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人一时被一圈声音的光环笼罩。
TALK:兽人双眼闪烁着声音光芒。

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "You need a new perspective."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“你需要换个角度看世界。”

test_cases.canonical: orc screams voice, "Let me show you how many colours things can be!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人尖叫 声音：“让我给你看看东西能有多少种颜色！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Beogh has given me so many different colours to drink."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“比欧弗给了我那么多种颜色来喝。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I was weak before I became an orc, but now I'm strong. And I'll get stronger."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“在变成兽人之前我很弱小，但现在我很强壮。而且我会越来越强。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Everything's been so different since that missionary gave me these suspenders."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“自从那位传教士给了我这副背带裤，一切都变得大不一样了。”
兽人咕哝道：“到处都是这么漂亮的颜色……”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "My favourite colour of blood is voice. Wait, no, voice."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我最喜欢的血的颜色是声音。等等，不对，是声音。”

test_cases.canonical: orc screams, "What are you staring at, orc? I'm stylish!" voice
test_cases.zh: 兽人尖叫道：“你在盯着看什么，兽人？我很时髦！”声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I didn't invite you."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我可没邀请你来。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "The world, the flesh, and the devil."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“尘世、肉身，与魔鬼。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "There's no good or evil. Just power and will."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“无所谓善恶。只有力量和意志。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You have all forgotten the taste of death."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你们都已经忘记了死亡的滋味。”

test_cases.canonical: orc claims, "I care not for such insignificant forces as time or death."
test_cases.zh: 兽人宣称：“我才不在乎时间或死亡这种微不足道的力量。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Magic. You know nothing about it."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“魔法。你对它一无所知。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Join my legions of the broken and the beaten."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“加入我那支由残破者和失败者组成的大军吧。”
声音
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "You haven't seen the last of me!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“你还没见到我最后一面呢！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I'll get you next time!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“下次我饶不了你！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "This isn't over yet!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“这事还没完！”
兽人说：“我会回来的！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This isn't the end, it's only just beginning!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这不是结束，这仅仅是个开始！”

test_cases.canonical: orc gasps with voice dying breath, "I... tried to warn you..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人用声音最后一口气喘息道：“我……试着警告过你……”

test_cases.canonical: orc gasps with voice dying breath, "No one... ever listens..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人用声音最后一口气喘息道：“从来没有人……肯听……”

test_cases.canonical: orc gasps with voice dying breath, "Your fate... be upon your own head..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人用声音最后一口气喘息道：“你的命运……终将由你自己承担……”

test_cases.canonical: orc begs you to reconsider your quest.
test_cases.zh: 兽人恳求你再考虑一下你的追寻。

test_cases.canonical: orc pleads, "Will you not heed even the word of a friend and end this?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人哀求道：“连朋友的话你都不肯听，不肯就此收手吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Even I cannot save you if you persist in this."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你若执意如此，连我也救不了你。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The life which is unexamined is not worth living."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“未经省察的人生不值得过。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "My goal is simple. It is a complete understanding of the universe, why it is as it is and why it exists at all."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我的目标很简单。那就是彻底理解这个宇宙：它为何如此，它又为何存在。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "One may say the eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“可以说，世界永恒的神秘之处就在于它能够被理解。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Which is more difficult, to awaken one who sleeps or to awaken one who, awake, dreams that he is awake?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“把睡着的人唤醒，和唤醒一个醒着却梦见自己醒着的人，哪个更难？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Everyone has the same god; only people differ."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“每个人都有同一个神；不同的只是人。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Against boredom even gods struggle in vain."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“面对无聊，就连众神也徒然挣扎。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "No facts are to me sacred; none are profane; I simply experiment, an endless seeker, with no past at my back."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“对我来说没有神圣的事实，也没有亵渎的事实；我只是不断实验，一个无止境的求索者，身后不留过去。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The present is the child, and the necessary child, of all the past, and the mother of all the future."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“现在是所有过去的孩子，也是必然的孩子，又是所有未来的母亲。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Reason is nothing but a wonderful and unintelligible instinct in our souls."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“理性不过是我们灵魂中一种奇妙而不可解的直觉。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "It is extremely absurd to expect to be enlightened by reason, and yet to prescribe to it beforehand on which side it must incline."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一方面期待被理性启蒙，一方面又预先规定理性必须倾向哪一边，这是极其荒谬的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The real reality is there, but everything you KNOW about 'it' is in your mind and yours to do with as you like."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“真实的现实就在那里，但你对‘它’所知道的一切都在你自己脑中，随你怎么处置。”
TALK:兽人思考着辩证唯物主义。
TALK:兽人琢磨着一个存在主义困境。

test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人把声音笔记塞进声音斗篷底下。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc heaves a sigh in contemplation.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人沉思着，长叹了一口气。

test_cases.zh: 兽人哭喊道：“你腿下断歌，不是吗？”
TALK:兽人怒目而视。
TALK:兽人原地转圈。

兽人说：“俺没疯！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What sane person could live in this world and not be crazy?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哪个神志正常的人能活在这世上而不发疯？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's that horrible smell? It's like... yuck."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“那股恶心味是什么？就像是……呃。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If there's anything I hate more than water, it's brackish swamp water."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“要说有什么比水更让我讨厌，那就是发臭的沼泽水。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hate trees. I hate swamp water. I hate this place."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我讨厌树。我讨厌沼泽水。我讨厌这个地方。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "That buzzing noise? I hate that the most."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“那嗡嗡声？那是最让我讨厌的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What could mosquitoes possibly want with my blood?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“蚊子要我的血干什么？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hope these swamp worms drown."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我希望这些沼泽虫全淹死。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Damn it, I left my flaming sword at home."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“该死，我把燃烧的剑忘在家里了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Don't you hate leeches? I know I do."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你不讨厌水蛭吗？反正我讨厌。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hate mosquitoes. Almost as much as I hate swamp water."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我讨厌蚊子。几乎跟我讨厌沼泽水一样多。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "At least there's some dry land. I hate getting wet."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“至少还有块干地。我讨厌浑身湿透。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Is there a plague of frogs happening, or something? At least it's not locusts."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这是闹蛙灾了吗还是怎样？至少不是蝗灾。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The more heads they grow, the more I hate hydras."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“九头蛇的头长得越多，我就越讨厌它们。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Tides? I despise tides. No, wait, I hate tides!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“潮汐？我鄙视潮汐。不对，等等，我讨厌潮汐！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I like turtle soup. I hate turtles."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我喜欢海龟汤。我讨厌海龟。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I haven't seen any pirates yet. I hate pirates."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我还没见到任何海盗。我讨厌海盗。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "At least this place doesn't smell as bad as the Swamp."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“至少这里没有沼泽那么难闻。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The sirens are starting to hurt my ears."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“那些塞壬开始震得我耳朵疼了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Are sirens supposed to sound like that? I can sing better than that!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“塞壬是该那样叫的吗？我唱得都比她们好听！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Where'd the sea come from? I thought this place was underground."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这片海是打哪来的？我还以为这里在地下。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I like the beach, but I hate the sea."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我喜欢沙滩，但我讨厌海。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "These tides are fast. That can't be natural!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这潮水涨得也太快了。这肯定不正常！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "At least there aren't any ducks around. I hate ducks."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“至少这附近没有鸭子。我讨厌鸭子。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I'm soaked through. I hate being wet!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我浑身湿透了。我讨厌浑身湿透！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Those krakens don't even look real."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“那些克拉肯看起来根本就不像真的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I'm looking for Ms. Medusa. Have you seen her?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我在找美杜莎女士。你们见过她吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I don't understand half of what these people say. It's all Greek to me."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这些人说的话我有一半听不懂。对我来说完全是天书。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "And I thought they were famous for their poetry."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我还以为他们以诗歌闻名呢。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I slipped earlier. I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我刚才滑了一跤。我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I wish these tides would just make up their mind. In and out, in and out..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“真希望这潮水能拿个准主意。涨了又退，退了又涨……”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "A turtle bit me. I hate turtles."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一只海龟咬了我。我讨厌海龟。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This tentacle just came out of nowhere and touched me. I hate tentacles!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这条触手不知从哪儿冒出来碰了我一下。我讨厌触手！”
声音
兽人说：“战利品都在哪儿？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I feel like a jelly sandwich, now."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“现在我感觉自己像一块果冻三明治。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This place is the Pits."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这地方就是个大坑。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hate the colour green."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我讨厌绿色。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I can't smell anything here. I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“在这里我什么都闻不到。我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I can't get this icky slime off my feet."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我脚上这黏糊糊的黏液怎么也弄不掉。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I keep getting this feeling like someone's watching me. Creepy."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我老觉得有人在盯着我。真瘆人。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I always freeze up when I think I'm being watched."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一想到有人在看我，我就会僵住。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Acid blobs make me think of reflux. I hate reflux."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“酸液团总让我想起胃酸倒流。我讨厌胃酸倒流。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's up with all this goo? It's like a world of goo. I hate goo."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这么多黏糊糊的东西是怎么回事？就像一个黏液世界。我讨厌黏液。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Someone said I could use acid to solve all my problems. It just made them worse."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“有人跟我说，用酸能解决我所有的问题。结果只是让问题更糟了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hope the rune isn't sticky."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“但愿这枚符文不是黏的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "A rock stubbed itself on my toe. I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一块石头自己绊到了我的脚趾上。我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's so magical about quicksilver, anyway?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“水银到底有什么神奇的？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You know that hissing noise? I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你听到那种嘶嘶声了吗？我讨厌那个。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You know that slithering noise? I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你听到那种滑行声了吗？我讨厌那个。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I'd like to make these snakes into gloves, but I hate gloves."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我倒是想把这些蛇做成手套，可我讨厌手套。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This place is the Pits."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这地方就是个大坑。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What do naga need barding for?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“纳迦要马甲做什么用？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's a barding, anyway? Does it sing for its supper?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“话说马甲是什么？它会唱歌讨饭吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Robes are for wimps. Real warriors wear heavy armour!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“长袍是给软蛋穿的。真正的战士要穿重甲！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Nagas are pretty ugly. I hate nagas."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“纳迦真是丑。我讨厌纳迦。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Did all the warriors here go to shield school or something?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这里的战士是不是都上过盾牌学校？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "So, why is that serpent talking?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“话说回来，那条蛇为什么会说话？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What sort of name is 'naga' anyway? They're not even good at nagging."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“‘纳迦’这算哪门子名字？他们连唠叨都不在行。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "At least there aren't any garudas. I hate garudas."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“至少这儿没有迦楼罗。我讨厌迦楼罗。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You'd think there'd be more pits. I haven't seen any."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“按说这儿的坑应该更多才对。我一个都没见着。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I'm sick of this place. Or maybe that's poison..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我受够这个地方了。或者，也许那是中毒了……”
兽人说：“我讨厌变异的蛇。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "So, nagas are stealthy? Don't make me laugh."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“所以，纳迦很擅长潜行？别逗我笑。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I wish they'd hurry up and stop blocking the corridors."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“真希望他们快点让开，别总堵着走廊。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Man, snails must be faster than these guys."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“天哪，蜗牛肯定都比这些家伙快。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How does a snake shoot lightning, anyway?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“蛇到底是怎么射出闪电的？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "First nagas, now salamanders. What's next, crocodiles with mirrors on their heads?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“先是纳迦，现在是火蜥蜴。接下来是什么，头顶镜子的鳄鱼？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "But I don't want to have to go deeper!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“可我不想再往更深处走啊！”
兽人说：“‘诡异’到底是什么意思？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I keep hearing this weird shrieking in my head. I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我脑子里老是听到奇怪的尖啸。我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I've never heard of a star cursing anything."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我可从没听说过哪颗星星会诅咒东西。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I've never heard of a star spawning anything."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我可从没听说过哪颗星星会生出东西来。”

test_cases.canonical: orc throws up voice hands and says, "Alright, I admit it, I'm lost!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人举起声音双手说：“好吧，我承认，我迷路了！”
兽人说：“我讨厌那种被硬生生撕扯的感觉。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's so abyssal about tentacles and stars?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“触手和星星到底哪里深渊了？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Screaming refractions? What's next, yodelling boulders?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“尖叫的折射体？接下来是什么，唱约德尔调的巨石？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I saw a draconian who kept changing colours. Some people are so indecisive."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我刚才看到一条一直在变颜色的龙人。有些人就是这么优柔寡断。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How come everyone is wearing a cloak down here?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“为什么这底下人人都披着斗篷？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I offered a draconian some spare armour, but he said it didn't fit."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我给了某条龙人一些备用护甲，但他说不合身。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I keep feeling something staring at me. Is it you?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我总觉得有什么东西在盯着我。是你吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How do you make a golem out of electricity?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“怎么用电力造出傀儡？”
兽人说：“‘宝珠守卫’到底是什么？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Orbs of fire, orbs of destruction, the Orb of Zot... what's with all the orbs?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“火焰宝珠、毁灭宝珠、佐特宝珠……怎么这么多宝珠？”
兽人说：“我讨厌宝珠。”
兽人说：“我讨厌小丑。”
兽人说：“我讨厌龙人。”
兽人说：“我讨厌紫色。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Are they setting up a circus down here?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“他们是在这底下搭马戏团吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This place probably doesn't see many tourists."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这地方大概没多少游客来。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Oh, so that's what those runes are for!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哦，原来那些符文是干这个用的！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Why do the walls change colour every floor? Did they keep running out of paint?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“为什么每层墙的颜色都不一样？他们的油漆老是不够用吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's stopping the guards from just stealing the Orb themselves?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“是什么拦着守卫们不自己把宝珠偷走？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I hope I don't run into any orbs of ice down here!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“希望我在这底下别撞上什么寒冰宝珠！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Did you bring your rings of ice?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你带上你的寒冰戒指了吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The Orb of Power is here? Where are the others, then?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“力量宝珠在这里？那其他的呢？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I saw some tasty-looking maize earlier, but it tried to eat me. I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我刚才看到一些看起来很美味的玉米，可它想吃我。我讨厌这样。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "So much for spreading the word; you get punched in the face instead."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“说到传播福音，结果就是脸上挨一拳。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "This pamphlet doesn't say what the point to Recitation is."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这份小册子没说明诵经到底有什么意义。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I wanna be an adventurer, not a preacher!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我想当冒险者，不想当传教士！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What does Zin need our gold for, anyway?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“辛到底要我们的金子干什么？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Something seems a little bit odd about a God who wants to be paid."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一个想要人付钱的神，总觉得有点不对劲。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I've got two hundred gold pieces. Is that enough to cure these mutations?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我有两百枚金币。这些够治好我身上的变异吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Didn't you like your horns?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你不喜欢你的角吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If I give you twenty gold pieces, can you get rid of this nasty case of scales I've got?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我给你二十枚金币，你能帮我弄掉这身讨厌的鳞片吗？”
兽人捂住声音耳朵。“闭嘴！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Wouldn't you get more for your money with Gozag?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“信哥萨戈的话，你的钱不是更划算吗？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How does a bone dragon fly, anyway?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“话说，骨龙到底是怎么飞的？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How do you flay a ghost, anyway?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“话说，你要怎么剥一个幽灵的皮？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Pah! You're not even a real necromancer."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“呸！你根本不算个真正的死灵法师。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Did you drop out of Necromancy School?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你是从死灵学院退学的吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Ah. You're responsible for all those zombies."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“啊。那些僵尸都是你搞出来的。”
兽人说：“我讨厌僵尸。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Zombies? Spectres? Don't you get bored without any real company?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“僵尸？幽灵？没有真正的同伴，你不觉得无聊吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Angels painted black are so last century."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“天使涂成黑色早就过时了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If you wanted the light to be dimmer, you could have said so."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你要是想让光暗一点，早说啊。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What kind of torch can only be lit once per level?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“什么样的火把一层只能用一次？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How does that torch stay lit when you throw its fire all over?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你把火把的火到处乱扔，它怎么还亮着？”
兽人说：“我讨厌被锁链拴着。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "At least you've got demons for company."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“至少你还有恶魔做伴。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Are you sure that summoning demons is a good idea?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你确定召唤恶魔是个好主意？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Hey, watch where you throw those bolts!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“嘿，小心点扔那些破坏弹！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What will you do after everything's destroyed?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“等一切都毁灭了，你打算干什么？”
兽人说：“我讨厌恶魔。”
兽人说：“我讨厌血。”
兽人说：“我讨厌受苦。”
兽人说：“我讨厌烙印。”
兽人说：“我讨厌契约。”
兽人说：“我讨厌地狱。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I just stubbed my toe. Does that mean I'm cleansed?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我刚撞到脚趾了。这是不是说明我被净化了？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If I carve 'Go Away' into myself, will Makhleb do that?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“如果我在自己身上刻上‘滚开’，马科列布也会这么干吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What's the Crucible of Flesh? Some kind of fancy barbecue place?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“血肉熔炉是什么？某家高级烤肉店吗？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Don't you wish for a portable bookcase?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你不想要一个便携书架吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Imagine how many trees were cut down to fuel your hobby."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“想想为了你的爱好，有多少树被砍倒了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Man, that must be some big library."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“天哪，那图书馆肯定大得吓人。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Found the spell you wanted yet?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你要找的法术找到了吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If you wanted to read so much, why didn't you become a librarian?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“既然你这么爱读书，怎么不去当图书管理员？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Did you remember that thing that you forgot? I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你想起你忘掉的那件事了吗？我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "It's like an all you can read... something."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“就像随便读……随便什么的。”
兽人说：“我讨厌书。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Surely there's a limit to the number of books you can carry. Right?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你能带的书肯定是有上限的吧。对吧？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "It's good how you can learn magic as if by magic."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你能像变魔法一样学会魔法，这挺好的。”
兽人说：“我讨厌法术。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Don't you just hate miscasts?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你就说，你不讨厌法术失误吗？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Whatever happened to, 'First, do no harm'?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“‘首先，不可伤害’这话都上哪儿去了？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Doesn't healing your enemies sound rather pointless?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“治疗你的敌人，听着就毫无意义，不是吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Maybe you should start praying."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“也许你该开始祈祷了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "If I give you my weapon, will you leave me alone?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我把武器给你，你就不烦我了吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Come on. Make me an offer of peace that I can't refuse!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“来吧。给我一个我无法拒绝的和平提议！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "For every monster you don't kill, I'll kill three."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你每少杀一个怪物，我就多杀三个。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Why would you want to visit the Abyss? For a holiday?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你为什么要去深渊？度假吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Nothing ever attacks me when I'm in the Abyss."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我在深渊里的时候，什么都不会来攻击我。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Are you going to banish me, too?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你也要把我放逐了吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The world's bad enough without you corrupting it."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“这世界已经够糟了，你别再腐化它了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You must really love eldritch horrors. I hate them."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你一定很喜欢那些诡异的恐怖之物。我讨厌它们。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How can a god be banished to the Abyss?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一个神怎么会被放逐到深渊？”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Beogh must be pretty vain, having all those worshippers get remade in Beogh's image."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“比欧弗一定很虚荣，让所有信徒都照着祂的样子重塑自己。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "One of the priests looked like she was going to ask me to join... I guess she changed her mind."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“有个女祭司看起来像要拉我入教……我猜她改主意了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You think walking on water is cool? I can swim."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你觉得在水上行走很酷？我会游泳。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Isn't it annoying when people just start challenging you, and you can't get away from them?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“别人突然来挑战你，你还甩不掉他们，这不是很烦吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I'd get sick of only having three followers at most."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“最多只能有三个追随者，我可受不了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "How do you find enough ash and charcoal to anoint them all?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你上哪儿找那么多草木灰和木炭来给他们涂油？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You'll need more than orcs to take me on."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“想拿下我，光靠兽人可不够。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Do you like preaching on mountaintops?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你喜欢在山顶上布道吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What is divine providence, anyway? I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“‘神意’到底是个什么？我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You'd better watch out. The one on the left looks like he gets lost easily."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你最好小心点。左边那个看起来很容易迷路。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You think you're the Messiah? I met another orc who thought that, too."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你以为你是弥赛亚？我还见过另一个兽人这么想呢。”
兽人说：“弥赛亚？我讨厌弥赛亚。”

test_cases.canonical: orc bows and submits to you. "Nah, just kidding."
test_cases.zh: 兽人鞠了一躬，向你臣服。“哈，开玩笑的。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Don't fight so hard! You'll just burn out."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“别那么拼命！你会把自己烧尽的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Huh, so Ignis will die when you do... how's that make you feel?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哦，所以伊格尼斯会在你死的时候一起熄灭……这让你什么感觉？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You'd think a god of fire would be a bit brighter."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你会以为火神多少该亮一点。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Feel like your fire's burning out? I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“觉得你的火快烧完了？我讨厌这样。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You know a god's a real winner when you're their only follower, right?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你是祂唯一的信徒，可见这位神有多成功，对吧？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Oh, I wondered where that burning smell was coming from."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哦，我还在想那股烧焦味是从哪来的。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Why not join one of those new, up-and-coming flame gods instead?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“为什么不改信那些新冒头、有前途的火焰神呢？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Doesn't it hurt to go crashing headfirst through the ceiling?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“一头撞穿天花板不疼吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Wow, you can rise to a higher floor... isn't that called 'climbing stairs'?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哇，你能升到上层去……那不就是叫‘爬楼梯’吗？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Wow, fire everywhere! I hate that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“哇，到处都是火！我讨厌这样。”
声音

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Life is a curse, you will soon understand."

test_cases.canonical: orc whispers: "Through my death, I saw my mistakes, and the mistakes of many more..."

test_cases.canonical: orc says with laughter: "And yet I knew I would end up like that..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人笑着说出：“可我早就知道自己会是这个下场……”

test_cases.canonical: orc promises, "I will read your future in your entrails."
test_cases.zh: 兽人许诺道：“我会从你的内脏里读出你的未来。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Nobody wants to follow a dead messiah!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“没人愿意追随一个死掉的弥赛亚！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I used to walk on water. Now I just fly over it."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我以前能在水面上行走。现在我不过是从水面上飞过。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I don't need an army to kill you!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我不需要军队也能杀了你！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "What's the hurry? You'll die anyway."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“急什么？你横竖都是死。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "You can run, but you can't hide!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“你能跑，但你躲不掉！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "If I can't kill you now, I'll help my descendant do it later."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“如果我现在杀不了你，往后我会帮我的后裔动手。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I'll give you a battle you'll never forget!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我会给你一场永生难忘的战斗！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I'm committing your attacks to memory."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我正在把你的招数一一记在心里。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Still so attached to shiny items?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“还这么舍不得那些亮闪闪的东西？”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Foolish people, craving for loot."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“愚蠢的人们，贪求着战利品。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "I didn't need trinkets in life, I don't need them now."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“我活着时不需要小饰品，现在也不需要。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says regretfully, "I wish I had corrupted all of this!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人遗憾地说：“我真希望我把这一切都腐化了！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "What a barren place. A pity you won't get a chance to visit the Abyss!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“多么荒芜的地方。可惜你没机会去深渊看看了！”

test_cases.canonical: orc proudly claims, "A renegade god deserves renegade ghosts."
test_cases.zh: 兽人自豪地宣告：“叛神者就该有叛神者的幽灵。”
兽人说：“风暴要来了……”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "Let nature run its course against you!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“就让大自然朝你倾泻它的力量吧！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "The earth shall destroy you!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“大地将毁灭你！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I was promised divine protection. So much for that."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我曾被许诺神明的护佑。结果就这。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "In life I battled great evil. Now I just battle."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我生前与巨大的邪恶作战。如今我只是一味作战。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "They say chivalry is dead. Well, so am I."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“人们说骑士精神已死。嗯，我也死了。”

test_cases.canonical: orc whispers, "I have become one of them."
test_cases.zh: 兽人低语道：“我已经变成了他们中的一员。”

test_cases.canonical: orc mumbles, "We raided the strongholds of evil. Now I walk alone."
test_cases.zh: 兽人嘟囔道：“我们曾突袭邪恶的堡垒。如今我独自游荡。”

test_cases.canonical: orc utters, "No lamp to guide me anymore..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人出声道：“再没有灯为我引路了……”

test_cases.canonical: orc yells, "Who would have thought, even in death it is a pleasure to sever!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人吼道：“谁能想到，就算死了，劈斩也还是件乐事！”

test_cases.canonical: orc screams in joy, "As in life, so in death: Kill! Kill!! Kill!!!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人狂喜地尖叫道：“生也如此，死也如此：杀！杀！！杀！！！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "It's your last dance!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“这是你的最后一支舞！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says voice, "Let me show you true rhythm."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说 声音：“让你见识见识什么叫真正的节奏。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "You either stomp with the beat or get stomped."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“你要么踩着节拍踏地，要么就被踏扁。”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I used to wander and follow the dancing life. Look where it got me."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我曾四处游荡，追随着舞蹈般的人生。看看它把我带到了哪里。”
兽人呐喊：“终于来了像样的观众！”

test_cases.canonical: orc voice, "I laugh when killing. So smile when dying. SMILE!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人声音道：“我杀人时大笑。所以临死时就微笑吧。微笑！”

test_cases.canonical: orc complains, "You're an easy kill, but not a fun one."
test_cases.zh: 兽人抱怨道：“你杀起来很容易，可一点也不好玩。”

test_cases.canonical: orc reminisces, "I miss the gifts and the pranks."

test_cases.canonical: orc ponders, "They're ugly as hell, too!"

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I prefer the Lair of the Beasts, to be honest. At least animals don't complain."

TALK:兽人义愤填膺地沉下脸。
TALK:兽人痛苦地嚎叫。
TALK:兽人痛苦地哀号。
TALK:兽人哭泣着。
TALK:兽人抽泣着。
兽人尖叫道：“好疼，好疼！”
TALK:兽人开始咳血。
兽人喊道：“求你了，杀了我吧！”
TALK:兽人开始过度换气。
TALK:兽人在极度痛苦中扭动。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc stares vacantly at voice hideously deformed hands.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人茫然地盯着声音畸形得可怕的手。

test_cases.canonical: orc asks, "What has happened to me?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人问道：“我这是怎么了？”

test_cases.canonical: orc asks, "What has been done to me?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人问道：“他们对我做了什么？”
TALK:兽人祈祷着求助。

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I think I died... I think I'm dead..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我想我死了……我想我已经死了……”

test_cases.canonical: orc wails, "So itchy! Itchy, itchy, itchy! Always itchy!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人哀号道：“好痒！痒，痒，痒！总是痒！”

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc gurgles, unable to form words.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人发出咯咯声，说不出话来。

test_cases.canonical: orc yells, "I will have my revenge on the monster who did this!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人喊道：“我一定要向做出这一切的怪物报仇！”

test_cases.canonical: orc mumbles, "Took all my skin, all gone, all gone..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人喃喃道：“把我的皮全拿走了，都没了，都没了……”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I was beautiful once. Now look at me."
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“我也曾美丽过。你看看我现在。”
TALK:兽人扭动着声音触手。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:A dozen eyes blink open in orc chest.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人胸腔上睁开十几只眼睛。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:Strange appendages sprout from orc back.
test_cases.zh: TALK:奇怪的附肢从兽人背上长出来。
TALK:兽人甩动着声音尾巴。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc suddenly sprouts two large horns!
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人突然长出两只大角！

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc flesh secretes a thick mucus.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人血肉分泌出黏稠的黏液。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:Hollow, blind eyes appear on orc head.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人头上出现了空洞而失明的眼睛。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:Suppurating sores blossom under orc eyelids.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人眼睑下绽出流脓的疮口。

test_cases.canonical: orc begs you to kill voice.
test_cases.zh: 兽人乞求你杀了声音。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc looks at voice body and cries without tears.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人看着声音身体，无泪地哭泣。

test_cases.canonical: orc screams, "I am only a sick, bizarre, defaced creation."
test_cases.zh: 兽人尖叫道：“我只是一个病态、怪异、被毁了容的造物。”

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc fiddles with voice portable altar.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人摆弄着声音便携祭坛。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc shuffles one of voice decks.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人洗着声音牌组中的一副。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc fans some cards from one of voice decks.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人从声音牌组中展开几张牌。

test_cases.canonical: TALK:orc deck briefly glows with a rainbow of weird colours.
test_cases.zh: TALK:兽人牌组短暂地闪起一道五颜六色的奇异光芒。

test_cases.canonical: orc chants, "Know when to hold 'em, know when to fold 'em..."
test_cases.zh: 兽人吟唱着：“该抓牌时抓牌，该弃牌时弃牌……”
兽人赞美兽人。

test_cases.canonical: orc grins. "So many cards! Brought to you by orc!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人咧嘴一笑。“好多牌啊！由兽人赞助！”
兽人拒绝了保险。

test_cases.canonical: orc draws voice. "Wait, this doesn't belong here!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了声音。“等等，这张牌不该在这儿！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws voice. "Wait, where'd this come from?"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了声音。“等等，这张是从哪儿来的？”

test_cases.canonical: orc fumbles a card and drops it. "Whoops!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人笨手笨脚地掉了一张牌。“哎呀！”

test_cases.canonical: orc says, "I wanted to be a wyvern-rider, but orc had other plans!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人说：“俺本来想当个飞龙骑士，可兽人另有安排！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Cloud. "No fresh air for enemies!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了云。“不给敌人留一口新鲜空气！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Elixir. "Healing and magic? Woohoo!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了灵药。“治疗加魔法？哇呼！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws Exile. "The Abyss is a horrible place!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了放逐。“深渊可是个可怕的地方！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Tomb. "I don't want to be sealed in with no windows!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了陵墓。“我可不想被关在没窗户的地方！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws Velocity. "Know when to walk away, know when to run."
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了迅捷。“该走开时就走开，该跑时就跑。”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Dance. "Hope the weapon's aim is true!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了舞蹈。“但愿那武器的准头够好！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Elements. "Elemental beasts everywhere!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了元素。“到处都是元素兽！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Illusion. "I have a twin now!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了幻象。“我现在有个双胞胎了！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Pentagram. "Hope the demon is friendly!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了五芒星。“但愿那恶魔是友善的！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Rangers. "New friends who can shoot!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了游侠。“会射箭的新朋友！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Swarm. "Bees, bees everywhere!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了蜂群。“蜜蜂，到处都是蜜蜂！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws the Swine. "I'm a pig now!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了猪。“我现在是头猪了！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws Torment. "Half my health gone? Yikes!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了折磨。“一半的生命值没了？哎呀！”
兽人抽到了幽魂。“吸取可疼了！”

test_cases.canonical: orc draws Wrath. "So many ways gods can punish you!"
test_cases.zh: 兽人抽到了愤怒。“神明惩罚你的办法可真多！”
